about: Lower bounds on the distance of the codes of transversal_t_codes/ from the doubling theorem of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Sec. III): d >= min(d_sd, d_tri + 2) at every doubling, from one qubit up. A record is written only when every self-dual input along its chain has a distance proved in this folder; self_dual_distance_proved_by names the test. columns_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the code's columns as compact JSON (master_catalog/constructions.digest), the circuit the catalogue stores. witness is a harmful fault of weight lower_bound. Written by transversal_t_codes/certify_distances.py.
tool: the doubling theorem of Jain and Albert (arXiv:2408.12752, Sec. III)
